caption: The drawing depicts a single, upright metallic pitcher with a highly reflective surface, rendered in grayscale. The pitcher features an ornate handle on the left side that curves outward and upward, ending in a decorative knob with a small finial at the top. The spout on the right side is elongated and shaped like an animal's head, complete with a small protruding ear or horn and an open mouth. The body of the pitcher is cylindrical with a rounded base and a slightly narrower neck, transitioning to a hinged lid at the top. The lid has concentric bands and a looped handle, allowing it to be lifted up. Horizontal decorative bands with intricate leaf or braided motifs encircle the upper part of the body, just below the neck and the lid. The highlight and shadow areas indicate a metallic sheen, with the entire composition set within a lightly bordered rectangle on a cream-colored background.
title: Pewter Pitcher
